title: Permute document
description: The result of one `recon permute` run: what the source scores as it stands, what each variant scored, and why the run stopped.

description.description: One line a human can read to decide whether to adopt it.

exact.description: Byte equality after relocation normalization: the only result that means the source reproduces the original.

optimization.description: The optimization level this variant was built at, when the variant is a change to the build rather than to the source. Null for a variant that edits the text.

command.description: The command that produced this, so an agent can tell two runs apart.

unit.description: The unit whose source was permuted.

source.description: The source file, as project.toml spells it.

function.description: The function every variant was scored against.

baseline_score.description: The score of the source as it stands. A variant is only interesting if it beats this.

candidate_count.description: How many variants the generator could prove equivalent, before the budget.

stopped_because.description: The budget, an exact match, no candidates, or a project that does not build.

variants.description: Every variant that was built, in the order it was tried.

best.description: The best-scoring variant that built, or null when nothing could be built. Read best_beats_baseline first: a variant that merely ties the source has found nothing.

best_source.description: Where the winning source was written for a human to adopt, or null when nothing was written.

optimization_levels.description: The levels this unit's toolchain offers, spelled the way its compiler spells them, when --flags asked for them to be tried. Empty when flags were not permuted, or the profile declares none.

best_optimization.description: The level the winning variant was built at, when what won was a change to the build rather than to the source.

best_write_error.description: Why the winning source could not be written. Never fatal: the search already ran.

best_beats_baseline.description: True when the best variant scores strictly above the source as it stands. This is the field to branch on.
